Here's what to expect from one of the most unusual entries on the Southeast Asian calendar — a race in Brunei.
verdict: The BMW Brunei International Half Marathon is a genuinely rare entry on the Southeast Asian calendar: a BMW-branded road race in Brunei, a country with one of the smallest running calendars in the region. Organised by AKIF Media Marketing & Event with registration already open at approximately BND 60–70, it offers two distances (21K and 10K) in the Berakas area of Bandar Seri Begawan. The December date is Brunei's wet season, but the country's equatorial climate means year-round humidity regardless. For runners chasing a rare country tick or wanting a half marathon in one of Southeast Asia's most under-visited destinations, this is a compelling — and bookable — option.

sections.heading: The Destination: Brunei, a Rare Country Tick
paragraphs: Brunei is one of the smallest and wealthiest nations in Southeast Asia — an oil-rich sultanate on Borneo's north coast with a running calendar that can be counted on one hand. [1] A half marathon here is a genuinely rare opportunity: the country has fewer annual road races than a single Thai province. For runners collecting country ticks, Brunei is one of Southeast Asia's hardest boxes to check.

sections.heading: The Race: BMW-Backed, AKIF-Organised
paragraphs: The BMW branding gives the event a premium positioning and commercial backing that most small-country races lack. [1] AKIF Media Marketing & Event is the local organiser, and the race is anchored in Berakas, a coastal suburb of Bandar Seri Begawan with wide roads and government-building precincts. Two distances — half marathon (21.098km) and 10km — keep the format focused.

paragraphs: Registration is open via bruneimarathon.com, with pricing reported at approximately BND 60–70 (roughly USD 45–52). [1] That's competitive for a BMW-branded international race.
